channel.title: Texas Legislature - Today's Filed Bills in the Senate
channel.description: Bills filed on 11/19/2026. An appearance of a bill on this list is a result of it being filed by a representative or senator.

item.title: SB 435 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Hall
item.description: Relating to the permitting of renewable energy generation facilities; authorizing fees.

item.title: SB 436 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Hall
item.description: Relating to the diagnosis, maintenance, and repair of certain motor vehicles; providing a civil penalty.

item.title: SB 437 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Hall
item.description: Relating to providing for the elimination of toll roads and projects in this state, including toll cessation by toll project entities and a prohibition on new toll project construction and on the conversion of nontolled lanes.

item.title: SB 438 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Hall
item.description: Relating to the prohibition of lane restrictions on a portion of Interstate Highway 635.

item.title: SB 439 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Hall
item.description: Relating to transporting an unsecured load; creating a criminal offense.

item.title: SB 440 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Hall
item.description: Relating to toll collection and enforcement by toll project entities; authorizing an administrative fee; imposing a civil penalty.

item.title: SB 441 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Hall
item.description: Relating to limitations and prohibitions on certain roadway projects and to a prohibition on the distribution of affordable housing funds to local governments that implement certain prohibited roadway projects.

item.title: SB 442 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Hall
item.description: Relating to prohibited lottery games involving drawings and the time allotted for a lottery prize payment.

item.title: SB 443 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Hall
item.description: Relating to the appointment of election clerks.

item.title: SB 444 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Hall

item.title: SB 445 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Hall
item.description: Relating to annual continuing education requirements for county election officers.

item.title: SB 446 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Hall

item.title: SB 447 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Hall

item.title: SB 448 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Hall

item.title: SB 449 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Hall
item.description: Relating to warning labels for opioid prescription drugs.

item.title: SB 450 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Hall
item.description: Relating to required labeling of food, medical, and cosmetic products containing, manufactured using, or derived from aborted human fetal tissue.

item.title: SB 451 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Hall
item.description: Relating to the statute of limitations for the offense of improper relationship between educator and student.

item.title: SB 452 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Hall

item.title: SB 453 Introduced
